verdicts.reason: The two candidates look identical: the same leaderboard layout. Both have the same flaws. The 'WEEKEND ONLY' kicker is pushed up against the top edge, above the CTA and away from the headline. The can is shrunk to a tiny orange speck squeezed between the copy and the button, so it no longer works as product imagery. The legal text is cramped against the right edge at almost body size, and the peach circle motif is gone.
